method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: the compilation of the Health Services Act 2016 retrieved 7 September 2026 (mrdoc 48912; compilation table to the Industrial Relations Legislation Amendment Act 2024, in operation 31 January 2025; Evidence Act 2025 s 492(1) uncommenced), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_48912.txt; with the Health Services (Fees and Charges) Order 2016, consolidated version 00-aw0-00, currency start 1 July 2026 (to SL 2026/142), as deposited at ../../../health-services-fees-and-charges-order-2016/registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49652.txt (cll 3, 3A, 5, 6, 6A, 7, 8, 10A, 11-15; Schedule 1 Divisions 1-4)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the public patient: Act s 5; s 7(3), (4) (public health service); s 8(4), (6)-(8) (public hospital); s 34(2)(f) (complaints procedure); ss 53A, 53B (compensation; paid or payable after 1 July 2023); ss 54, 55 (the provider may charge unless the National Health Agreement or a s 56(2)(b) order says not; no charge inconsistent with the Order or a policy framework); s 56(2) (its effect); s 57 (payable by or for the patient; waiver); ss 57A, 57C, 57D (recovery of compensable charges out of compensation); ss 217, 219, 220 (disclosure of patient information; $5 000 fine). Order: classes of patient (cll 3, 3A, 11-15, Medicare eligibility borrowed from the Health Insurance Act 1973 and asked as a fact); no fees for Medicare-ineligible asylum seekers and involuntary patients (cl 6A); the daily charges for public, private, nursing home type, veteran, ineligible and compensable in-patients, day patients and same day patients ($0, $467, no more than $774, $82.50, $239.20, $3 417, $3 529, $385, $7 202, $4 305, $385, $3 258, $4 465); out-patient services ($0 or $397); out-patient medicines ($0, no more than $7.70, no more than $25, or at cost under cl 10A); accompanying persons ($46); MRI (Division 3); pathology (Division 4, MBS amount an input). Not encoded: the machinery (Parts 2, 3, 5, 7-16, 18, 19); s 59; s 57B; s 58 regulations; orthoses (cl 9) and prostheses (cl 10, Division 6); the National Health Reform Agreement, regulations and policy frameworks (not deposited; asked as facts).
